change.description: Add a new method CompactWithDeletionMarkers(ctx context.Context, markers []DeletionMark) error to the Syncer struct in thanos/pkg/compact. This enables deletion-mark-aware compaction where the Syncer can accept a list of deletion markers and exclude those blocks from its internal metadata map before compaction planning. This is particularly important for multi-tenant systems like Mimir where tenant-specific deletion markers need to be injected into the compaction lifecycle for safe block deletion across tenants.

breaking_patterns.pattern: Code that extends or wraps Syncer functionality
breaking_patterns.why_breaks: Mimir's metaSyncer struct mirrors the Thanos Syncer pattern and provides similar methods for multi-tenant compaction. When CompactWithDeletionMarkers is added to Thanos Syncer, Mimir needs a parallel implementation in metaSyncer to support tenant-specific deletion-mark-aware compaction workflows.

breaking_patterns.pattern: Unit tests that instantiate or mock Syncer
breaking_patterns.example:
syncer, err := compact.NewMetaSyncer(...)
syncer.SyncMetas(ctx)
syncer.GarbageCollect(ctx, blocks)
// Tests must now cover CompactWithDeletionMarkers
breaking_patterns.why_breaks: Test files that validate Syncer behavior need to add test cases for the new CompactWithDeletionMarkers method to ensure deletion markers are properly handled and blocks are correctly filtered from the in-memory map.

breaking_patterns.pattern: Code that uses Syncer and needs deletion-mark-aware behavior
breaking_patterns.why_breaks: Compaction orchestration code that manages the Syncer lifecycle may need to call the new CompactWithDeletionMarkers method to properly handle deletion markers before planning compaction groups, especially in multi-tenant scenarios.

breaking_patterns.pattern: Structs that embed or use Syncer and DeletionMark types
breaking_patterns.why_breaks: Code that already works with DeletionMark structures and deletion filtering needs to integrate with the new Syncer method to maintain consistent deletion mark handling across the compaction pipeline.

The method should: (1) Accept ctx context.Context and markers []metadata.DeletionMark as parameters; (2) Lock s.mtx to safely modify the blocks map; (3) Iterate through the provided markers and delete matching block IDs from s.blocks; (4) Optionally update metrics to track blocks removed via deletion markers; (5) Return error if context is cancelled or any unexpected error occurs. impacted_files.suggested_fix: Consider integrating BlocksCleaner with the new Syncer.CompactWithDeletionMarkers method: After BlocksCleaner deletes marked blocks, it could call syncer.CompactWithDeletionMarkers to immediately update the Syncer's in-memory state, ensuring consistency between object storage and the Syncer's block metadata without waiting for the next SyncMetas call.
